name: Moonlight Sins
source:
Take on the role of a famous lawyer as your ostentatious lifestyle faces new challenges. You'll need to try to maintain your friendships, advance on romantic interests, and most importantly, win. Just when everything starts to fit together, it falls apart. Can you handle the stakes? Can you salvage your reputation? Only time can tell, as you're about to take your biggest case yet...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thengineer]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名著名律师，在奢华张扬的生活迎来新挑战时作出选择。你需要努力维系友谊，推进感情关系，更重要的是赢得胜利。就在一切似乎逐渐步入正轨时，局面却分崩离析。你能承受这场豪赌吗？能挽回自己的声誉吗？只有时间会给出答案，因为你即将接手迄今最大的一宗案件……

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/thengineer]Patreon[/url]]
